The Farwell Name. Numerous records from before 1900 or so spell the name Farewell.

While I was growing up, several of my relatives from this family lived very near, on Blackberry Hill Road in Berwick. By that time, the name they all used was Farwell.

We pronounced the name in a more or less typical Maine fashion, softening or droppng the R sound. As a result, the name sounded like the word vowel, but starting with an F.
